page.overview:
What is Tantalos?

Tantalos was a location, possibly a planet, which was lorded over by the House Atreides. It was given to Baron Demetrios Atreides by Padishah Emperor Sheuset I.. The lordship lasted into the time of Duke Mintor Atreides, probably the last known Lord of Tantalos.
